intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna is peering at a knobbly brown root through her magnifying lens. She sniffs it, then sniffs it again.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Damp. Pressure dropping. By tomorrow, every knee over fifty will be forecasting rain.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “In Hollowmere, nobody discusses the weather. We treat it.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She sniffs the root a third time and writes something down.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She goes back to the root. You appear to have been discharged.

options.labelText: “Do you ever talk about anything normal?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She puts the root in a pocket and buttons the pocket shut.

options.labelText: “What is that? You’ve smelled it three times.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Four. One was before you got here.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “*Valeriana officinalis*. Smells like a boot that’s been through something. Brew it and you sleep. Show it to a cat and the cat proposes.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She holds it out for you to sniff. It does smell like a boot.
